b.x: For whoever searches ‘food storage’, ‘water per person’, and ‘what to keep at home’.
01 Why store Ordinary margin. Not prophecy — a Tuesday without a market.
02 Water Three liters per person per day. Without this, the rice does not matter.
03 How much to keep The household’s count, not the internet’s. FIFO. What the family already eats.
04 Hygiene Illness arrives before hunger. Bucket, soap, trash — the kit nobody posts.
05 Blackout One torch. Not several candles. Light that does not advertise the house.
06 The house as a base Shutoff, breaker, the neighbor with the key. The island is the real address.
